extracted.intended_audience: 3D printing hobbyists / Thingiverse users who want a token holder sleeve
extracted.subtask_description: Design and 3D-print a sleeve to hold tabletop/story-point tokens; includes a Fusion 360 source file, printing notes, and a suggested assembly method. The page describes capacity, printability, and removal considerations for the printed part.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capacity (holds 15 tokens)
rubrics_metrics.description: Holds 15 of the tokens from cazantyl (https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:2967077) nicely. After printing the tokens, I didn't like them being scattered. So I made a sleeve to house them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design target: accommodate 15 tokens comfortably; purpose is to prevent tokens being scattered. Can be adjusted by editing the provided design file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Retention / assembly method
rubrics_metrics.description: I use a rubber band to hold it together.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical, low-tech retention recommended: use a rubber band to keep the sleeve assembled. No built-in fastening mechanism described.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design file included / modifiability
rubrics_metrics.description: Designed in fusion 360 with design file included if you want to adjust how many tokens it should hold for you.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Source (Fusion 360) file is provided to allow users to modify capacity or other dimensions before printing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Printability — no supports needed
rubrics_metrics.description: I designed it to be easily 3d printed. No supports needed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Geometry and orientation chosen to avoid the need for support structures, simplifying printing and post-processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chamfered base for easy removal
rubrics_metrics.description: Chamferd base for easy removal from print bed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Base is chamfered to reduce adhesion or make it easier to remove the part from the print bed without damage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Usage license — Attribution 4.0 International
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design is shared under CC BY 4.0; users must provide attribution when reusing or redistributing the design.
